sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r3/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: 'Quality Checks' row 24 (grading_wiring_is_structurally_correct); 'Internal Quality Checks' row 24 (annotation: 'reward.toml and every judge.toml are structurally complete: pinned judge, browser MCP server, well-typed criteria with weights, valid aggregate' - legacy wording, applied to staged scoring.toml); 'Deterministic Checks' rows check-rubric-schema.py and check-scoring-policy.py (which own most of this row)

.qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r3/rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/** (diffed test.sh, tools/score.py, tools/restart_mcp.py, scoring.toml, and the [judge]/[mcp_servers]/[scoring] header of all five judge.toml files)
evidence: Static structure verified by reading and by a tomllib parse of the frozen bytes. (1) task/tests/scoring.toml:1-11 = [gates] render=0.0, constraints=0.0; [weights] functional=0.6, polish=0.2, visual=0.2 (sum 1.0); [floors] functional=0.05; byte-identical to the template scoring.toml; every name has its directory (tests/gates/render, tests/gates/constraints, tests/scored/functional|polish|visual all exist). (2) All five judge.toml headers ([judge] judge='claude-code', mode='batched', isolated=false, prompt_template='prompt.md', [[judge.mcp_servers]] playwright stdio playwright-mcp --headless --isolated --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium --no-sandbox, [scoring] aggregation) are byte-identical to the frozen template headers (diff of everything up to the first [[criterion]]). No model/reasoning_effort/temperature/weight key in any [judge] block. (3) Gates: gates/render/judge.toml:14-20 and gates/constraints/judge.toml:14-20 use aggregation='all_pass' with one binary criterion each (hro_gate_render, hro_gate_shared), weight 1.0, non-empty descriptions. (4) Scored: functional 43 criteria all binary, weights positive (total 58.5), aggregation weighted_mean; polish 5 binary, total 12.0; visual 5 likert with points=5 and 5..1 anchors in each description (scored/visual/judge.toml:18-90). All ids unique within and across files (hro_gate_*, hro_*, hro_pol_*, hro_vis_*); id==name everywhere. (5) Restart server: only scored/functional/judge.toml:14-18 declares name='verifier', command='/usr/local/bin/python3', args=['/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py','$APP_RESTART_HELPER']; test.sh:127-193 generates $LOG_DIR/app-restart.sh by heredoc+sed, chmod 755, removes the .used marker and `export APP_RESTART_HELPER="$LOG_DIR/app-restart.sh"` before run_suite; restart_mcp.py reads sys.argv[1] and is single-use via a .used marker; test.sh, score.py and restart_mcp.py are byte-identical to the template. Only functional prompt.md mentions restart_app (prompt.md:1 and protocol D line 51); no other prompt references it. (6) Prompts resolve: every prompt.md contains exactly {app_context} (line 3) and {criteria} (lines 13/13/53/20/18); a brace scan of all prompt.md, app_context.md and all *.toml finds no other '{' or '}' so neither test.sh's str.replace nor any format-style substitution can break; each prompt opens http://localhost:3000. (7) Budgets nest with --max-concurrent-agent 1: gates 600+600=1200 < 1500; scored 9000+900+900=10800 < 11100; 1500+11100=12600 < task.toml [verifier].timeout_sec 13200. (8) score.py resolves scoring.toml at Path(__file__).parent.parent (tests/tools/ is one level under tests/). Adversarial probes: a dead/static app cannot pass the wiring because gates are all_pass binary with threshold >0.0 and score.py exits 1 on gate failure (test.sh:216-222), keeping reward 0; a conforming app is not penalised by wiring because restart uses the same APP_ENTRY/APP_DB chosen at launch and the helper is exported before the scored suite. Risk flag: raw-evidence-index.json states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'; no hash-bound RewardKit run of THIS candidate demonstrates the suites load, the $APP_RESTART_HELPER expansion reaches restart_mcp.py, and reward.json is produced. Wiring is template-identical, so the structural verdict stands, but the required full verifier launch/grading record is missing and cannot be waived.
